Package kieker.model.analysismodel.type

Interface ComponentType

All Superinterfaces:
org.eclipse.emf.ecore.EObject, org.eclipse.emf.common.notify.Notifier
All Known Implementing Classes:
ComponentTypeImpl
public interface ComponentType extends org.eclipse.emf.ecore.EObject
A representation of the model object 'Component Type'.

The following features are supported:

  • Signature
  • Provided Operations
  • Name
  • Package
  • Provided Storages
  • Contained Components
  • Provided Interface Types
  • Required Interface Types
